primary.$description: Primary theme color. Main brand color for primary CTAs, links, and key interactive elements. Use for primary buttons, active navigation, focus states. Bootstrap's --bs-primary maps to blue-500. Ensures consistent brand expression across all touchpoints. Verify 4.5:1 contrast on backgrounds.

secondary.$description: Secondary theme color. Supporting UI elements, secondary actions, and muted emphasis. Use for secondary buttons, subtle badges, disabled state text. Bootstrap's --bs-secondary maps to gray-600. Provides visual hierarchy below primary actions. Meets WCAG AA for text.

success.$description: Success theme color. Positive feedback, confirmations, and successful operations. Use for success messages, checkmarks, positive badges, form validation. Bootstrap's --bs-success maps to green-500. Universal indicator of positive outcomes. Ensure 4.5:1 with backgrounds.

info.$description: Info theme color. Informational content, tips, and neutral notifications. Use for info alerts, help text, tooltips, neutral badges. Bootstrap's --bs-info maps to cyan-500. Communicates helpful information without urgency. Maintain contrast standards.

warning.$description: Warning theme color. Cautions, warnings, and important notices requiring attention. Use for warning alerts, pending states, cautionary badges. Bootstrap's --bs-warning maps to yellow-500. May require dark text overlay for accessibility. Test contrast carefully.

danger.$description: Danger theme color. Errors, destructive actions, and critical alerts. Use for error messages, delete buttons, critical alerts, form errors. Bootstrap's --bs-danger maps to red-500. Universal indicator of risk or problems. Ensure strong contrast.

light.$description: Light theme color. Light backgrounds, subtle surfaces, and low-emphasis elements. Use for page backgrounds, card backgrounds, light UI surfaces. Bootstrap's --bs-light maps to gray-100. Provides subtle separation. Use with dark text (700+).

dark.$description: Light theme color. Light backgrounds, subtle surfaces, and low-emphasis elements. Use for page backgrounds, card backgrounds, light UI surfaces. Bootstrap's --bs-light maps to gray-100. Provides subtle separation. Use with dark text (700+).

primary.$description: Primary background color utility. Applies primary brand color as background. Use with .text-white for proper contrast. Maps to Bootstrap's .bg-primary utility class. Provides brand-consistent primary surfaces.

secondary.$description: Secondary background color utility. Applies secondary color as background. Use for supporting UI surfaces. Maps to Bootstrap's .bg-secondary utility class. Provides visual hierarchy.

success.$description: Success background color utility. Applies success color as background. Use for positive feedback surfaces. Maps to Bootstrap's .bg-success utility class. Indicates successful operations.

danger.$description: Danger background color utility. Applies danger color as background. Use for error or destructive action surfaces. Maps to Bootstrap's .bg-danger utility class. Indicates errors or warnings.

warning.$description: Warning background color utility. Applies warning color as background. Use for caution or important notice surfaces. Maps to Bootstrap's .bg-warning utility class. Requires careful contrast checking.

info.$description: Info background color utility. Applies info color as background. Use for informational surfaces. Maps to Bootstrap's .bg-info utility class. Communicates helpful information.

light.$description: Light background color utility. Applies light gray as background. Use for subtle surfaces and page backgrounds. Maps to Bootstrap's .bg-light utility class. Requires dark text for contrast.

dark.$description: Dark background color utility. Applies dark gray as background. Use for high-contrast surfaces and footers. Maps to Bootstrap's .bg-dark utility class. Requires light text for contrast.

body.$description: Body background color utility. Applies default body background color. Use for main content areas. Maps to Bootstrap's .bg-body utility class. Matches default page background.

white.$description: White background color utility. Applies pure white as background. Use for cards and elevated surfaces. Maps to Bootstrap's .bg-white utility class. Maximum brightness.

black.$description: Black background color utility. Applies pure black as background. Use for maximum contrast surfaces. Maps to Bootstrap's .bg-black utility class. Requires white text.

transparent.$description: Transparent background color utility. Removes background color. Use for overlay elements or to reset backgrounds. Maps to Bootstrap's .bg-transparent utility class.

5.$description: 5% opacity. Use for very subtle overlays or hover states.

10.$description: 10% opacity. Use for subtle overlays or disabled states.

15.$description: 15% opacity. Use for light overlays or hover effects.

20.$description: 20% opacity. Use for subtle backgrounds or shadows.

25.$description: 25% opacity. Use for overlay backgrounds or disabled elements.

60.$description: 60% opacity. Use for visible but translucent elements.

65.$description: 65% opacity. Use for mostly visible elements.

70.$description: 70% opacity. Use for mostly opaque elements.

80.$description: 80% opacity. Use for nearly opaque elements.

85.$description: 85% opacity. Use for mostly solid elements.

90.$description: 90% opacity. Use for almost fully opaque elements.

95.$description: 95% opacity. Use for very nearly solid elements.

100.$description: 100% opacity. Fully opaque, no transparency.

border-color-translucent.$description: Translucent border color that blends with backgrounds using rgba().

body-color.$description: Default body text color. Applied to the <body> element and inherited by all text content unless overridden.

body-bg.$description: Default body background color. Applied to the <body> element as the base page background.

emphasis-color.$description: Emphasis color for higher contrast text. Use for headings or text that needs to stand out.

secondary-color.$description: Secondary text color for lighter, less prominent text. Use for captions, labels, or helper text.

secondary-bg.$description: Secondary background color. Use for dividers and to indicate disabled component states.

tertiary-color.$description: Tertiary text color for even lighter text. Use for less important supporting text.

tertiary-bg.$description: Tertiary background color. Use for hover states, accents, and wells.

link-color.$description: Default hyperlink color. Used for all <a> elements and interactive text.

link-hover-color.$description: Hyperlink hover color. Applied when user hovers over a link.

border-color.$description: Default border color for component borders, dividers, and rules.

primary-text-emphasis.$description: Primary text emphasis color - higher contrast text on light backgrounds.

primary-bg-subtle.$description: Primary subtle background color for non-intrusive backgrounds.

primary-border-subtle.$description: Primary subtle border color for gentle borders matching primary theme.

secondary-text-emphasis.$description: Secondary theme text emphasis color - higher contrast text on light backgrounds.

secondary-bg-subtle.$description: Secondary theme subtle background color for non-intrusive backgrounds.

secondary-border-subtle.$description: Secondary theme subtle border color for gentle borders matching secondary theme.

success-text-emphasis.$description: Success text emphasis color - higher contrast text on light backgrounds.

success-bg-subtle.$description: Success subtle background color for non-intrusive success states.

success-border-subtle.$description: Success subtle border color for gentle borders matching success theme.

danger-text-emphasis.$description: Danger text emphasis color - higher contrast text on light backgrounds.

danger-bg-subtle.$description: Danger subtle background color for non-intrusive error states.

danger-border-subtle.$description: Danger subtle border color for gentle borders matching danger theme.

warning-text-emphasis.$description: Warning text emphasis color - higher contrast text on light backgrounds.

warning-bg-subtle.$description: Warning subtle background color for non-intrusive warning states.

warning-border-subtle.$description: Warning subtle border color for gentle borders matching warning theme.

info-text-emphasis.$description: Info text emphasis color - higher contrast text on light backgrounds.

info-bg-subtle.$description: Info subtle background color for non-intrusive info states.

info-border-subtle.$description: Info subtle border color for gentle borders matching info theme.

light-text-emphasis.$description: Light text emphasis color - provides contrast on light themed components.

light-bg-subtle.$description: Light subtle background color for subtle backgrounds.

light-border-subtle.$description: Light subtle border color for gentle borders matching light theme.

dark-text-emphasis.$description: Dark text emphasis color - highest contrast text on light backgrounds.

dark-bg-subtle.$description: Dark subtle background color for darker backgrounds.

dark-border-subtle.$description: Dark subtle border color for borders matching dark theme.

100.$description: Lightest tint (90% lighter) of primary brand color. Subtle backgrounds, ghost button hover states, and alert backgrounds. Use for disabled states and low-emphasis surfaces. Insufficient contrast for text. Background use only. Not suitable for text. Decorative use or with dark text (check contrast).

200.$description: Very light tint (75% lighter) of primary brand color. Secondary backgrounds, skeleton loaders, and inactive states. Hover states for light surfaces, disabled backgrounds. Low contrast. Combine with 700+ for text. Use with 600+ colors for accessible text contrast (4.5:1 minimum).

300.$description: Light tint (60% lighter) of primary brand color. Borders, dividers, input backgrounds, and tertiary buttons. Active borders, focus ring alternatives, subtle emphasis. Medium-low contrast. Pair with 800+ for body text. Achieves 3:1 for large text with white, 4.5:1 with 800+ colors.

400.$description: Medium-light tint (40% lighter) of primary brand color. Prominent borders, icon fills, active states, and focus indicators. Hover states for interactive elements, selected states. Moderate contrast. Use with white backgrounds for UI elements. Meets 3:1 non-text contrast. Use 900 for text pairing.

500.$description: Base color (reference) of primary brand color. Primary actions, links, badges, and brand expression. Default state for buttons, active navigation, emphasis. Strong contrast with white. Test with light backgrounds. Typically meets 4.5:1 with white for text. Verify for each color.

600.$description: Dark shade (20% darker) of primary brand color. Hover states for primary actions, pressed states, focus rings. Button hover, active navigation, emphasized borders. High contrast. Excellent for interactive states. Strong contrast with white (7:1+). Safe for all text uses.

700.$description: Darker shade (40% darker) of primary brand color. Active/pressed states, secondary text, icon emphasis. Button pressed, selected items, high-emphasis text. Very high contrast. Versatile for text and UI. Exceeds 7:1 with white. Optimal for small text and icons.

800.$description: Very dark shade (60% darker) of primary brand color. Body text on light backgrounds, headings, strong emphasis. Text primary color, icon fills, critical information. Maximum contrast on light backgrounds. WCAG AAA compliant (10:1+) with white. Ideal for readability.

900.$description: Darkest shade (80% darker) of primary brand color. Maximum contrast text, critical alerts, Dark surfaces. Headline text, error text, highest priority content. Near-black contrast. Reduces eye strain vs pure black. Exceeds WCAG AAA (12:1+). Superior to black for extended reading.

400.$description: Medium-light tint (40% lighter) of neutral interface color. Prominent borders, icon fills, active states, and focus indicators. Hover states for interactive elements, selected states. Moderate contrast. Use with white backgrounds for UI elements. Meets 3:1 non-text contrast. Use 900 for text pairing.

500.$description: Base color (reference) of neutral interface color. Primary actions, links, badges, and brand expression. Default state for buttons, active navigation, emphasis. Strong contrast with white. Test with light backgrounds. Typically meets 4.5:1 with white for text. Verify for each color.

600.$description: Dark shade (20% darker) of neutral interface color. Hover states for primary actions, pressed states, focus rings. Button hover, active navigation, emphasized borders. High contrast. Excellent for interactive states. Strong contrast with white (7:1+). Safe for all text uses.

700.$description: Darker shade (40% darker) of neutral interface color. Active/pressed states, secondary text, icon emphasis. Button pressed, selected items, high-emphasis text. Very high contrast. Versatile for text and UI. Exceeds 7:1 with white. Optimal for small text and icons.

800.$description: Very dark shade (60% darker) of neutral interface color. Body text on light backgrounds, headings, strong emphasis. Text primary color, icon fills, critical information. Maximum contrast on light backgrounds. WCAG AAA compliant (10:1+) with white. Ideal for readability.

900.$description: Darkest shade (80% darker) of neutral interface color. Maximum contrast text, critical alerts, Dark surfaces. Headline text, error text, highest priority content. Near-black contrast. Reduces eye strain vs pure black. Exceeds WCAG AAA (12:1+). Superior to black for extended reading.

white.$description: Pure white (#FFFFFF). Primary background for Light. Use for cards, page backgrounds, and high-contrast surfaces. Ensures maximum contrast with dark text. WCAG AAA compliant with gray-900 text (21:1 ratio).

black.$description: Pure black (#000000). Reserved for maximum contrast scenarios. Use sparingly for critical text or borders requiring highest emphasis. Prefer gray-900 for most dark text needs to reduce eye strain.

100.$description: Neutral gray 100 alias. References brand.gray.100. Use for consistent gray tones across light/Darks. Maintains semantic meaning while adapting to theme context. See brand.gray.100 for detailed usage guidance.

200.$description: Neutral gray 200 alias. References brand.gray.200. Use for consistent gray tones across light/Darks. Maintains semantic meaning while adapting to theme context. See brand.gray.200 for detailed usage guidance.

300.$description: Neutral gray 300 alias. References brand.gray.300. Use for consistent gray tones across light/Darks. Maintains semantic meaning while adapting to theme context. See brand.gray.300 for detailed usage guidance.

400.$description: Neutral gray 400 alias. References brand.gray.400. Use for consistent gray tones across light/Darks. Maintains semantic meaning while adapting to theme context. See brand.gray.400 for detailed usage guidance.

500.$description: Neutral gray 500 alias. References brand.gray.500. Use for consistent gray tones across light/Darks. Maintains semantic meaning while adapting to theme context. See brand.gray.500 for detailed usage guidance.

600.$description: Neutral gray 600 alias. References brand.gray.600. Use for consistent gray tones across light/Darks. Maintains semantic meaning while adapting to theme context. See brand.gray.600 for detailed usage guidance.

700.$description: Neutral gray 700 alias. References brand.gray.700. Use for consistent gray tones across light/Darks. Maintains semantic meaning while adapting to theme context. See brand.gray.700 for detailed usage guidance.

800.$description: Neutral gray 800 alias. References brand.gray.800. Use for consistent gray tones across light/Darks. Maintains semantic meaning while adapting to theme context. See brand.gray.800 for detailed usage guidance.

900.$description: Neutral gray 900 alias. References brand.gray.900. Use for consistent gray tones across light/Darks. Maintains semantic meaning while adapting to theme context. See brand.gray.900 for detailed usage guidance.

primary.$description: Primary theme color. Main brand color for primary CTAs, links, and key interactive elements. Use for primary buttons, active navigation, focus states. Bootstrap's --bs-primary maps to blue-500. Ensures consistent brand expression across all touchpoints. Verify 4.5:1 contrast on backgrounds.

secondary.$description: Secondary theme color. Supporting UI elements, secondary actions, and muted emphasis. Use for secondary buttons, subtle badges, disabled state text. Bootstrap's --bs-secondary maps to gray-600. Provides visual hierarchy below primary actions. Meets WCAG AA for text.

success.$description: Success theme color. Positive feedback, confirmations, and successful operations. Use for success messages, checkmarks, positive badges, form validation. Bootstrap's --bs-success maps to green-500. Universal indicator of positive outcomes. Ensure 4.5:1 with backgrounds.

info.$description: Info theme color. Informational content, tips, and neutral notifications. Use for info alerts, help text, tooltips, neutral badges. Bootstrap's --bs-info maps to cyan-500. Communicates helpful information without urgency. Maintain contrast standards.

warning.$description: Warning theme color. Cautions, warnings, and important notices requiring attention. Use for warning alerts, pending states, cautionary badges. Bootstrap's --bs-warning maps to yellow-500. May require dark text overlay for accessibility. Test contrast carefully.

danger.$description: Danger theme color. Errors, destructive actions, and critical alerts. Use for error messages, delete buttons, critical alerts, form errors. Bootstrap's --bs-danger maps to red-500. Universal indicator of risk or problems. Ensure strong contrast.

light.$description: Light theme color. Light backgrounds, subtle surfaces, and low-emphasis elements. Use for page backgrounds, card backgrounds, light UI surfaces. Bootstrap's --bs-light maps to gray-100. Provides subtle separation. Use with dark text (700+).

dark.$description: Light theme color. Light backgrounds, subtle surfaces, and low-emphasis elements. Use for page backgrounds, card backgrounds, light UI surfaces. Bootstrap's --bs-light maps to gray-100. Provides subtle separation. Use with dark text (700+).

primary.$description: Primary background color utility. Applies primary brand color as background. Use with .text-white for proper contrast. Maps to Bootstrap's .bg-primary utility class. Provides brand-consistent primary surfaces.

secondary.$description: Secondary background color utility. Applies secondary color as background. Use for supporting UI surfaces. Maps to Bootstrap's .bg-secondary utility class. Provides visual hierarchy.

success.$description: Success background color utility. Applies success color as background. Use for positive feedback surfaces. Maps to Bootstrap's .bg-success utility class. Indicates successful operations.

danger.$description: Danger background color utility. Applies danger color as background. Use for error or destructive action surfaces. Maps to Bootstrap's .bg-danger utility class. Indicates errors or warnings.

warning.$description: Warning background color utility. Applies warning color as background. Use for caution or important notice surfaces. Maps to Bootstrap's .bg-warning utility class. Requires careful contrast checking.

info.$description: Info background color utility. Applies info color as background. Use for informational surfaces. Maps to Bootstrap's .bg-info utility class. Communicates helpful information.

light.$description: Light background color utility. Applies light gray as background. Use for subtle surfaces and page backgrounds. Maps to Bootstrap's .bg-light utility class. Requires dark text for contrast.

dark.$description: Dark background color utility. Applies dark gray as background. Use for high-contrast surfaces and footers. Maps to Bootstrap's .bg-dark utility class. Requires light text for contrast.

body.$description: Body background color utility. Applies default body background color. Use for main content areas. Maps to Bootstrap's .bg-body utility class. Matches default page background.

white.$description: White background color utility. Applies pure white as background. Use for cards and elevated surfaces. Maps to Bootstrap's .bg-white utility class. Maximum brightness.

black.$description: Black background color utility. Applies pure black as background. Use for maximum contrast surfaces. Maps to Bootstrap's .bg-black utility class. Requires white text.

transparent.$description: Transparent background color utility. Removes background color. Use for overlay elements or to reset backgrounds. Maps to Bootstrap's .bg-transparent utility class.

5.$description: 5% opacity. Use for very subtle overlays or hover states.

10.$description: 10% opacity. Use for subtle overlays or disabled states.

15.$description: 15% opacity. Use for light overlays or hover effects.

20.$description: 20% opacity. Use for subtle backgrounds or shadows.

25.$description: 25% opacity. Use for overlay backgrounds or disabled elements.

60.$description: 60% opacity. Use for visible but translucent elements.

65.$description: 65% opacity. Use for mostly visible elements.

70.$description: 70% opacity. Use for mostly opaque elements.

80.$description: 80% opacity. Use for nearly opaque elements.

85.$description: 85% opacity. Use for mostly solid elements.

90.$description: 90% opacity. Use for almost fully opaque elements.

95.$description: 95% opacity. Use for very nearly solid elements.

100.$description: 100% opacity. Fully opaque, no transparency.

border-color-translucent.$description: Translucent border color that blends with backgrounds using rgba().

body-color.$description: Default body text color. Applied to the <body> element and inherited by all text content unless overridden.

body-bg.$description: Default body background color. Applied to the <body> element as the base page background.

emphasis-color.$description: Emphasis color for higher contrast text. Use for headings or text that needs to stand out.

secondary-color.$description: Secondary text color for lighter, less prominent text. Use for captions, labels, or helper text.

secondary-bg.$description: Secondary background color. Use for dividers and to indicate disabled component states.

tertiary-color.$description: Tertiary text color for even lighter text. Use for less important supporting text.

tertiary-bg.$description: Tertiary background color. Use for hover states, accents, and wells.

link-color.$description: Default hyperlink color. Used for all <a> elements and interactive text.

link-hover-color.$description: Hyperlink hover color. Applied when user hovers over a link.

border-color.$description: Default border color for component borders, dividers, and rules.

primary-text-emphasis.$description: Primary text emphasis color - higher contrast text on light backgrounds.

primary-bg-subtle.$description: Primary subtle background color for non-intrusive backgrounds.

primary-border-subtle.$description: Primary subtle border color for gentle borders matching primary theme.

secondary-text-emphasis.$description: Secondary theme text emphasis color - higher contrast text on light backgrounds.

secondary-bg-subtle.$description: Secondary theme subtle background color for non-intrusive backgrounds.

secondary-border-subtle.$description: Secondary theme subtle border color for gentle borders matching secondary theme.

success-bg-subtle.$description: Success subtle background color for non-intrusive success states.

success-border-subtle.$description: Success subtle border color for gentle borders matching success theme.

danger-text-emphasis.$description: Danger text emphasis color - higher contrast text on light backgrounds.

danger-bg-subtle.$description: Danger subtle background color for non-intrusive error states.

danger-border-subtle.$description: Danger subtle border color for gentle borders matching danger theme.

warning-text-emphasis.$description: Warning text emphasis color - higher contrast text on light backgrounds.

warning-bg-subtle.$description: Warning subtle background color for non-intrusive warning states.

warning-border-subtle.$description: Warning subtle border color for gentle borders matching warning theme.

info-text-emphasis.$description: Info text emphasis color - higher contrast text on light backgrounds.

info-bg-subtle.$description: Info subtle background color for non-intrusive info states.

info-border-subtle.$description: Info subtle border color for gentle borders matching info theme.

light-text-emphasis.$description: Light text emphasis color - provides contrast on light themed components.

light-bg-subtle.$description: Light subtle background color for subtle backgrounds.

light-border-subtle.$description: Light subtle border color for gentle borders matching light theme.

dark-text-emphasis.$description: Dark text emphasis color - highest contrast text on light backgrounds.

dark-bg-subtle.$description: Dark subtle background color for darker backgrounds.

dark-border-subtle.$description: Dark subtle border color for borders matching dark theme.
